name: curriculum-rung1
description: The swimmer curriculum's first rung. D236's switching tank, rung 1: D184's tank of 3,400 m2 (leaf-direction-patches-w7's) with its 31 leaves in two discs of 7 m radius on a ring of 21 m, so that 28 m of bare water lies between the discs at the start and at least 4.9 m between each disc and the glass, and with the discs taking turns being fed. The radius is 7 m in place of D236's draft of 6 m, by the coordinator's calibration of 2026-10-25: over the 520 seeds --check lays, 6 m found no place for a leaf in 64 draws in 3 first deals and in 6 of 1,034 fresh complements, 6.5 m in 2 first deals, and 7 m in none. The margin to the glass, 4.9 m at its least, is under the smell's reach of 6 m, so a leaf near the rim can be smelled from beside the glass; the bench reads whether that matters. The fed disc regrows: a leaf that leaves the living there is replaced 120 s later by a fresh one drawn from the leaf pool. Every 600 s the feeding switches, so at 600 s and 1,200 s of the 1,800 s episode: both old discs wither, each leaf dying at a random second within 300 s and leaving no food, and the disc now fed is laid afresh at an angle on the ring at least 120 degrees from the disc that withered (leaves.patches.switching: period 600, regrowAfter 120, witherOver 300, minimumTurn 120). The world's overrides add, to leaf-direction-patches-w7's, the eating rule of round 62's screen r62cs-w500 (rounds/env-r62cs-w500.ps1 over rounds/env-r62ce.ps1): ContactEating on (D219, D220), BiteTakesStore on (D224) and RemainsWindowSeconds at 500 (D220), with the intake scale at 16 (D227) as D232's screen r62kg runs it, every other mouth dial as the nursery config has it; and the two switches the moving-oasis screen carries: Fluid.ShapedAddedMass on (the fin law, D229) and Development.ReflectMirroredAnchors on (the mirrored joint, D228). D232's gut is not on this branch and joins the eating rule after D232's read; D231's assembly push and D234's mirrored drive are not on this branch either, and stay off. Only food from leaves counts as eaten (Organism.FoodFromLeavesJoules), so a swimmer that bites another is not fed by it. The founders are the twenty of inocula/r59-direction-blades/pool-mixed.tsv, round 59's ten leaf tops (inocula/r59-direction-tops) and the same ten with the round limb replaced by a flat blade of equal volume (D236), as the nursery pool rounds/nursery/pools/39d06aac2d0d0f60.tsv (scripts/reads/curriculum-pool.py makes it), each on body 0 with its own brain. The search is leaf-direction-patches's (population 48, 8 draws, evolve kind, the stop on eaten with window 5, gain 0.05, over 10, floor 20, at most 60 generations); the score is EnergyReturn with chargeDeathToEnd; the exam swims the top of every generation and the last elites on 32 held-out episodes under five brains: their own, none, the leaf smell knocked out, a frozen stroke (every power at -1) and constant full power. Travel is read at the exam and never scored. A draft: the coordinator calibrates the switching numbers on curriculum-bench before any arm. Every other setting is leaf-direction-patches-w7's, whose description was: leaf-direction-patches on integration-1's world config format (mouth.killSwallowsBody, D232, at false, which leaves the world as it was): its world config is e80c201e54b3963f's successor 9fa947462638667c, which is e6bdb9c74cb48742's config (the one leaf-direction-patches named) on round 60's format (world.matterIslandGlassMarginMetres (D185) at 0, as e80c201e54b3963f) with mouth.killSwallowsBody (D232) that integration-1 added, at false, and the 45 tunables the round-62 build added, the 27 coral keys (D194's branching coral; coral.reefShape at Mushroom and its dials at their defaults), development.reflectMirroredAnchors (D228), development.scaleLengthensOnce (D199), feeding.plantsKeepMatter (D206), feeding.plantsKeepOwnFirst (D207), field.corpseHalfLifeSeconds (D212), fluid.shapedAddedMass (D229), mouth.biteDamageScale (D226), mouth.biteTakesStore (D224), mouth.contactEating (D219, D220), mouth.intakeReachFromMouth (D214), mouth.intakeScale, mouth.remainsWindowSeconds (D220), physics.dragLimitAtEveryStep (D196, D199), physics.dragLimitByWeldedBody (D199), world.contactShape (D228), world.matterBurialDesertPerSecond (D190), world.readAcrossSeams (D204) and world.seedOverrides (D192), at their defaults; all of them leave the tank as it was. Every other setting as leaf-direction-patches, whose description was: D182's patchy tank (laid out as D184 approved): leaf-direction-return in a tank of 3,400 m2 in place of 400 m2, its 31 leaves in 3 equal patches of 6 m radius whose centres lie 120 degrees apart on a ring of 21 m about the axis, the ring turned by an angle each episode draws, so 24 m of bare water lies between patches and 6 m between each patch and the glass. The bred bodies start anywhere in the tank. The score (EnergyReturn), the prices, the founders and their brains, the body search, the stop on eaten and the exam are leaf-direction-return's.
